title: The Citation Brief
blurb: A free, cited newsletter on business-valuation and trust-estate regulatory developments — every claim resolves to a real, independently verified source. New issues added here as they publish.

title: GovCon Change Digest
blurb: A free, no-signup weekly digest of Federal Register procurement rule changes — FAR, DFARS, SBA, GSAR. See what changed and when it takes effect, pulled live from the Federal Register API in your browser. No accounts needed.

title: Far-Deadline Calendar
blurb: A free, no-signup timeline of upcoming Federal Register procurement deadlines (FAR, DFARS, SBA rules) — comment-close dates and effective dates, grouped by urgency, auto-refreshed from live data in your browser. No accounts needed.

title: Polymarket Scanner
blurb: A free, no-signup, no-wallet scanner for Polymarket prediction markets: browse live markets by 24h volume, liquidity, or closing date, filter by keyword, and see the crowd's implied probability at a glance. Reads Polymarket's public data in your browser.

title: Market Movers
blurb: A free, no-signup page ranking Polymarket prediction markets by implied probability change — see which markets moved most in the last 24–48 hours. Filters, search, and live refresh from Polymarket's API in your browser.

title: Prediction Market Scanner (Apify Actor)
blurb: The scanner as a data feed: binary markets from Polymarket and Manifold in one schema, with the price spread between venues on every matched market. Pay per event on the Apify Store.

title: Flashcard Study Tool
blurb: A free flashcard app with SM-0 spaced repetition, multiple decks, and statistics — no signup, no ads, works offline. Installs to your homescreen as a PWA. All your data stays in your browser.

title: Currency API
blurb: A small exchange-rate API serving live rates from public ECB data. Hosted as a running service.
